WBL is a U.S.-based company with a fully remote workforce.

This is a remote contract/consultant position with working hours from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

The role requires excellent command of written and spoken English. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Position Summary

The Asset Resolution Team Lead (also known as Case Management Team Lead) manages an assigned portfolio of distressed short-term, real estate collateralized commercial loans. They provide mentorship and support to Asset Resolution Analysts (ARAs), each managing their own distressed loan portfolios. The Team Lead is responsible for portfolio ownership, case analysis, recovery operations, and working with outside counsel to optimize asset resolution.

Key responsibilities include developing and monitoring collection, loss mitigation, and recovery strategies in collaboration with outside counsel, managing case administration, analysis, and reporting.

This leadership role requires managing a large asset portfolio, providing clear instructions to external parties, familiarity with legal proceedings (preferably in the U.S.), and financial analysis skills or experience in structured finance. Candidates should be comfortable with leadership duties and mentoring junior staff.

Essential Functions

  • Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio.
  • Develop, train, and supervise a team of Asset Resolution Analysts.
  • Develop and update policies and procedures.
  • Conduct pipeline management and financial analysis.
  • Implement recovery strategies.
  • Oversee litigation, bankruptcy, and foreclosure activities, including drafting and reviewing legal documents.
  • Liaise with attorneys, collection agencies, and vendors.
  • Engage with customers and their counsel for negotiations and conflict resolution.
  • Maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare reports on case status, performance, outcomes, budgets, and forecasts.
  • Collaborate on financial reporting, valuations, and legal strategies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (preferred from U.S. institution).
  • Paralegal Certificate or equivalent (preferred).
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

The Aircraft Mechanic II (Engine) repairs, services, and troubleshoots malfunctions on aircraft engine systems (T-700GE-700 or T-55-L-714).

  • Maintain and repair aircraft engine components.
  • Apply technical knowledge of aircraft engine systems in determining equipment malfunctions and use required expertise in restoring equipment condition and/or operation.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • U.S. military technical school or specialized training course is desired, certification of education level is required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700GE-700 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Or A&P license and two (2) years aviation maintenance experience within the last five (5) years on T-700-GE-701 Series engines and/or T-55-L-714 engines.
  • Must be in possession of a U.S. Passport with minimum 2 plus year validity and 6 blank pages, and be able to travel internationally.

  • Must be able to obtain Iraq Visa.
  • Must be able to pass CENTCOM Medical requirements for deployment.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Thorough knowledge of aircraft mechanical component troubleshooting, repair procedures, and replacement of parts.

  • Working knowledge of technical publications and Logistics Information Systems.
  • Able to prioritize workloads to maintain schedules on assigned projects.
  • Participate in maintenance test flights and operation checks as required.

  • The incumbent receives technical guidance, as required, from supervisor or higher-level technician, and may be required to make entries in aircraft logs and records.

Physical Requirements/Working Environment

  • Must be able to walk and stand on level and/or inclined surfaces for extended periods throughout the day.

  • Must be able to crouch, crawl, grasp or handle objects, use finger dexterity, bend elbow/knee and reach above/below shoulders.

  • May be required to operate power vehicles, machinery, hand tools, ground support equipment, fork lift, etc.
  • Must be able to lift/push/pull minimum of 50 pounds.
  • May work in maintenance shop or outside.
  • Must be able to work in a shop where the environment is drafty, noisy, and dirty.
  • May be exposed to extreme noise from operating equipment.
  • May be exposed to electrical shock hazards or work near moving mechanical parts or vehicles.
  • May be expected to work in austere environments and all weather conditions.

description:
Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO - PRONTO SOCORRO role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. A rede de atenção às urgências e emergências se caracteriza pela rápida resposta aos quadros agudos de natureza clínica ou traumática que ocorrem fora do ambiente hospitalar. É fundamental para garantir suporte e a sobrevivência das pessoas vitimadas por quadros de maior gravidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Prestar assistência segura, humanizada e individualizada, desde a admissão até a transferência de setor, sob supervisão do enfermeiro;
  • Verificar sinais vitais, administrar medicações e realizar procedimentos assistenciais, sempre com foco na segurança e na redução de riscos de infecção;
  • Preencher registros específicos relacionados à assistência e prontuário, conforme normas institucionais e orientação do enfermeiro;
  • Garantir a adequada comunicação entre as equipes durante o plantão;
  • Preparar e prover materiais, equipamentos e insumos necessários para os procedimentos, zelando pela correta utilização e conservação;
  • Auxiliar o médico e prestar suporte na realização de exames e cuidados específicos do paciente;
  • Monitorar o posicionamento de cateteres, sondas e drenos, reportando irregularidades ao enfermeiro;
  • Cumprir as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem e as rotinas institucionais;
  • Realizar procedimentos dentro das técnicas assépticas e seguir orientações do Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes a função.
Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Urgência/Emergência (Pronto Socorro), UTI ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em urgência/emergência.
Informações adicionais:
  • Atuação na região de Diadema na escala 12x36.
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Company Description

Are you passionate about digital, data, IoT or AI and want to help a dynamic and ambitious team on a human scale?

Talan is an international advisory group on innovation and transformation through technology, with 5000 employees, and a turnover of 600M€.

We offer our customers a continuum of services to support you at each key stage of your organization's transformation, with 4 main activities:

Consulting: in management and innovation: supporting business, managerial, cultural, and technological transformations.
Data & Technology: to implement major transformation projects.
Cloud & Application Services: to build or integrate software solutions.

Talan accelerates its clients' transformation through innovation and technology. By understanding their challenges, with our support, innovation, technology and data, we enable them to be more efficient and resilient.

We believe that only a human-oriented practice of technology will make the new digital age an era of progress for all. Together let's commit!

Job Description

Main Tasks:

  • As an observability specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, and performance of our organization's systems and services.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to understand the requirements for observability and monitoring of their services.
  • You will work closely with our development and operations teams to design, implement, and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions that enable us to identify and resolve issues quickly.
  • Enable and leverage the observability practice.
  • Act as a fellow squad member.
  • Promote and leverage the near-zero manual actions in the administration and upgrade of systems, together with the development of incident automatic responses.
  • Design, implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Jaeger, etc.
  • Leverage the monitoring processes so they map the underlying business processes they support.
  • Ensure that observability and monitoring systems are set up to provide actionable insights that can be used to improve system stability, performance, and availability.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to observability systems, including data quality, system availability, and performance.
  • Continuously evaluate new and emerging observability technologies and tools, and make recommendations for their adoption.
  • Develop and maintain documentation on observability systems and procedures.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Solid knowledge in public clouds: AWS, Azure, GCP.
  • Experience with tools such as Dynatrace (Required), Netcool, Devo, Netscout, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Jaeger, etc.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience in dealing with large data sets.
  • Basic knowledge about Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
  • Proficient in English language.
  • Understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Permanent, full-time contract.
  • Smart Office Pack so that you can work comfortably from home.

A Fundação Educacional Lucas Machado (Feluma) nasceu em 29 de setembro de 1971 como instituição filantrópica, nos moldes do Decreto Federal 62.396/68, com a finalidade de contribuir com o desenvolvimento da comunidade por meio de atividades educacionais de saúde e assistência social, além de realizar pesquisas nos campos das Ciências Exatas, Humanas e Biológicas.

A organização é subdividida em cinco institutos, criados para garantir o cumprimento da missão da Fundação de promover a educação e a saúde e contribuir com a redução das desigualdades. São eles: Faculdade Ciências Médicas de Minas Gerais (FCM-MG); Ambulatório Ciências Médicas de Minas Gerais (ACM-MG); Hospital Universitário Ciências Médicas (HUCM-MG); Instituto de Olhos Ciências Médicas de Minas Gerais (IOCM-MG); e Teatro Feluma.

Dentre os institutos, o de maior destaque é a Faculdade Ciências Médicas de Minas Gerais (FCM-MG), que oferece pesquisa, ensino e extensão nos níveis das melhores instituições do país. À Faculdade estão subordinados o Hospital Universitário (HUCM-MG), o Ambulatório (ACM-MG) e o Instituto de Olhos Ciências Médicas de Minas Gerais (IOCM-MG), com atendimento 100% SUS e que figuram entre os principais centros de saúde de Belo Horizonte.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.

  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.

  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.

  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.

  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Como Profissional de Liderança Técnica DevOps você vai:

  1. Criar e sustentar toda a infraestrutura necessária para desenvolvimento e setup de Software das tribos sob sua responsabilidade incluindo repositórios de código, pipelines, versionamento, ferramentas de automação de testes, etc.
  2. Cuidar de todas as plataformas utilizadas pelas tribos de soluções como plataformas de integração e automações.
  3. Entender necessidades das tribos para o desenvolvimento de soluções e interagir com os times especialistas de infraestrutura para garantir a entrega das dependências necessárias.
  4. Desenvolver sistemas e aplicações conforme requisitos especificados e prazos estipulados; entender oportunidades para melhorar LeadTime e qualidade dos times, propor e implementar melhorias de processos e automações para aumentar a eficiência do ciclo de desenvolvimento de soluções.
  5. Levar conceito e cultura “Shift Left” para suas tribos, para que as mesmas consigam pensar em necessidades de segurança, observabilidade e operação durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento das soluções.

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

  • Background e experiência em middleware, de preferência em Middleware Oracle.
  • Experiência em fluxos Git Flow e Trunc Based;
  • Ferramentas CI/CD, Ferramentas de qualidade e automação de código.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Prometheus, Grafana ou Splunk.

Uma empresa global, movida à inovação e desafios

Presente em mais de 25 países , a Radix conecta pessoas, oportunidades, projetos e negócios no mundo todo. Nós criamos e transformamos conhecimento em resultados.

Com times multidisciplinares e forte atuação em Engenharia, Automação, Desenvolvimento de Software e Produtos, TI Industrial e Consultoria, oferecemos serviços e soluções tecnológicas atendendo os mais variados setores da indústria.

Desde a nossa fundação, em 2010, estamos na lista das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro, no Brasil e na América Latina. Aqui, a gente investe em criatividade, diversidade, capacitação e desenvolvimento de carreira. Quando um radixer cresce, nós crescemos também.

A rotina da Radix é dinâmica, colaborativa e Everywhere , com profissionais atuando de 23 estados do Brasil, além de Estados Unidos, Europa e Ásia. Nosso modelo de trabalho possibilita o equilíbrio para pessoas que estão sempre em movimento, gostam de liberdade e vivem a tecnologia e a inovação sem fronteiras.

Somos inquietos, entusiastas da mudança e abraçamos a transformação sem perder os valores que guiam nossa trajetória: relações de longo prazo, foco nas pessoas, ética, agilidade e comprometimento.

Join to apply for the Sr Demand Planner role at Crocs, Inc.

Overview

The Sr. Demand Planner Brazil coordinates activity across the functional and time spectrums to deliver a mid/long-term Demand Plan to ensure profitable business growth and in-stock levels for Core product. The role reports to the local Manager, Customer Operations & Planning Brazil, with a regional dotted line to the Director of Wholesale Planning based in the United States.

This includes, but is not limited to, driving cross-functional collaboration with key commercial partners to align on Demand Plan roll-up and reconciliation with financials, Open to Buy plan, in-season coordination, and MFP process seasonal handoff to Global Planning teams. The Sr. Demand Planner Brazil is also responsible for maintaining seasonal and monthly plans in the o9 Planning tool and participating in key business reviews with Brazil commercial & merchandising leadership and Global Planning partners.

What You'll Do

  1. Own the Demand Plan for Brazil in alignment with commercial needs as we approach seasonal buy execution.
  2. Interpret changes in buying process into product investment, adjusting for revenue and inventory balance.
  3. Focus on New Product / Key Product initiatives; coordinate core carryover seasonal items with planning and supply teams.
  4. Lead DP o9 plan creation for all sub-channels, ensuring timely delivery of monthly milestones, and support system enhancements.
  5. Lead inventory and supply planning to proactively manage in-stock levels.
  6. Propose seasonal and in-season stocking strategies balancing margin/revenue with working capital.
  7. Coordinate upstream supply chain actions to monitor, adjust, and troubleshoot supply lines and optimize inventory.
  8. Manage the local planning tool for OTB process and recommend buys accordingly.
  9. Drive cross-functional collaboration with commercial partners to align on the final OTB plan.
  10. Present various scenarios to leadership based on inventory turns and promotional activities.
  11. Coordinate supply and demand efforts, maintaining OTB data elements.
  12. Participate in demand plan consolidation for North America.
  13. Communicate key business drivers to country commercial leads for demand plan changes.
  14. Provide monthly inventory projections to the Global S&OP team.
  15. Work with Global MFP to integrate seasonal plans into regional-channel plans.
  16. Coordinate with regional merchandisers to ensure priorities are reflected in MFP tools.
  17. Participate in IBP/Seasonal Plan Alignment and other meetings representing Brazil’s sales channels.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  1. Degree in business, supply chain, planning, or related field, or extensive relevant work experience.
  2. At least 5 years of OTB/Demand planning experience in a multichannel environment, especially in apparel/footwear.
  3. Proficiency in English and Portuguese.
  4. Familiarity with inventory and service level planning.
  5. Experience with Merchandising Financial Planning and/or Integrated Business Planning.
  6. Extensive Excel skills and experience with MFP and demand planning systems, ideally with o9 Solutions.
  7. Minimal travel expected.

NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon; das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.

Função
Prazo indeterminado

O que você vai fazer por aqui?

Esta pessoa apoiará a definição da estratégia de planejamento comercial para os produtos (vendas digitais e serviços) da Natura e Avon Brasil em um projeto estratégico da empresa, considerando a visão do consumidor final e da consultora de beleza, as diretrizes e a estratégia omnicanal, buscando o equilíbrio entre as alavancas de vendas (comunicação, propaganda, amostragem, campanhas, etc.) e prezando pelos impactos nas diversas dimensões do negócio (públicos, categorias, canais e regiões) e nos objetivos estratégicos da companhia (força da marca, valor e experiência de compra, vendas, margens, custos e perdas).

Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para compartilhar com a nossa rede?

  • Liderar o planejamento, sendo responsável por entender o contexto interno e de mercado, e buscar os indicadores orçados em relação a Faturamento, Margem e Esforço Promocional;
  • Construir a Estratégia Comercial e grade de promoções;
  • Construir em conjunto com time de projeto o melhor plano de Atendimento;
  • Entender e explicar os desvios do piloto em relação ao planejado, sendo responsável por propor e implementar planos de ação no que diz respeito a grade proporcionada e estratégia de lançamentos;
  • Briefing dos materiais de comunicação;
  • Elaboração e condução de apresentações para liderança;
  • Responsável pelos indicadores (Receita Bruta, Margem Bruta, Esforço Promocional, Desconto Percebido, Estoque);

O que precisa ter?

  • Excel avançado;
  • PowerPoint ou Google Presentation avançado;
  • Conhecimento em SAS, Tableau ou PowerBI;
  • Forte raciocínio analítico e quantitativo: Habilidade com números, análise de dados, elaboração e teste de hipóteses para gerar conclusões e recomendações;
  • Execução proativa e engajadora: Senso de dono, alta capacidade de realização, mobilização e engajamento de pessoas para fazer acontecer;
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração: Facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis, comunicação eficaz, colaboração e capacidade de ensinar;
  • Diferencial: Experiência na gestão de categorias (visão mercadológica), construção de estratégias comerciais, análises de dados.

O que você vai encontrar por aqui?
Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido.
